title: astragalus palans var. araneosus
intro: Astragalus palans var. araneosus, commonly known as the hairy astragalus, is a plant species in the legume family, native to the mountainous regions of China. It has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to boost the immune system, reduce inflammation, and improve cardiovascular health, due to its health benefits of lowering blood pressure and improving circulation. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus palans var. araneosus include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids. Research has identified a range of bioactive compounds in this plant, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
